summary: Israeli forces destroyed a Hamas ambush point in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, located 50 meters from the Yellow Line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, and 170 meters from a school. Iran's atomic energy chief stated IAEA cannot inspect attacked nuclear sites until a protocol is drafted, citing wartime conditions. In Lebanon, reports emerged of IDF detonating civilian homes in Bani Hayyan, artillery shelling in Kafr Rumman, and explosions in Mazraat Bayt al-Siyad, while Oman reportedly halted cooperation with the US on escorting oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz.
key_points: IDF destroyed a Hamas ambush point and weapons depot in Jabaliya, northern Gaza, located 50 meters from the Yellow Line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, and 170 meters from a school, killing several militants. (Source: @idf_telegram/24989)

Iran's atomic energy chief told state media that Iran remains in a wartime state and IAEA cannot inspect attacked nuclear sites until a protocol is drafted, with only unstruck sites inspected in the past month. (Source: @N12chat/223661)

A Palestinian woman armed with a knife was apprehended by IDF troops at the Ginot Shomron junction in the Samaria Brigade after Shin Bet intelligence indicated she planned a stabbing attack. (Source: @idf_telegram/24994)
Reports indicate IDF forces detonated civilian homes in the town of Bani Hayyan in southern Lebanon, according to Press TV footage. (Source: @presstv/204266)

Lebanese Red Link reported artillery shelling in Kafr Rumman and an explosion in Mazraat Bayt al-Siyad in southern Lebanon, while requesting public reports of hostile drone or warplane activity. (Source: @redlinkleb/38753)

Oman reportedly halted cooperation with the United States on escorting oil tankers through the southern part of the Strait of Hormuz, according to a single uncorroborated source. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387054)

Rare footage reportedly shows Kaman-12 drones operated by the IRGC Air Force inside hardened underground tunnel facilities in Iran, with one drone appearing to launch from the protected tunnel. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387045)
IDF Chief of Staff Zamir met with US Air Force Chief of Staff General Kenneth Wilsbach on Sunday, alongside IAF Commander Tishler. (Source: @inon_yttach/9953)

points: Iran's atomic energy chief told Iranian state media that the country remains in a wartime state and that IAEA cannot demand inspections of nuclear sites until a mutual protocol is drafted, citing security conditions. In the past month, only unstruck nuclear sites were inspected. (Source: @N12chat/223661)

Rare footage reportedly shows Kaman-12 drones operated by the IRGC Air Force inside hardened underground tunnel facilities in Iran, with one drone appearing to launch from the protected tunnel, providing protection from surveillance and aerial attacks. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387045)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment shows continued active IDF operations in northern Gaza, including targeted strikes on Hamas infrastructure within 50 meters of the Yellow Line, indicating persistent militant presence in the area. Iran's declared wartime status and refusal to allow IAEA inspections of struck nuclear sites represent a significant escalation in nuclear diplomacy, though only unstruck sites have been inspected in the past month. Reports of multiple security incidents in southern Lebanon, including home demolitions in Bani Hayyan, artillery shelling in Kafr Rumman, and explosions in Mazraat Bayt al-Siyad, suggest ongoing kinetic activity along the Israel-Lebanon border. The single uncorroborated report of Oman halting US cooperation on Strait of Hormuz oil tanker escorts, if verified, could have major implications for regional maritime security and US force posture in the Gulf.
sections.regional_response: A US official quoted by Axios stated that the US is not currently negotiating with Iran and is instead applying heavy pressure that could bring Iran back to the negotiating table, indicating a continued maximum pressure posture. The meeting between IDF Chief of Staff Zamir and US Air Force Chief of Staff General Wilsbach alongside IAF Commander Tishler demonstrates sustained high-level US-Israel military coordination during the current period. Iranian parliamentary speaker Ghalibaf publicly criticized US Treasury Secretary Bessent's contradictory statements about sanctions, reflecting Iranian governmental pushback against US economic pressure. The deployment of IRGC Special Forces in Yazd Province and nationwide high-alert orders for multiple military units, possibly linked to fuel shortage concerns, indicate internal Iranian security preparations that may have regional security implications.
sections.intelligence_notes: The juxtaposition of Iran's wartime declaration regarding nuclear site inspections with the destruction of a Hamas ambush point 50 meters from the Yellow Line and 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital indicates a multi-front security environment requiring continuous monitoring. The reported Iranian underground drone facilities housing Kaman-12 drones, if verified, would represent a hardened and survivable strike capability that complicates targeting analysis. The US tanker tracking movements noted by open-source intelligence, including multiple KC-135 and KC-46 aircraft movements, suggest sustained aerial refueling and logistics activity potentially related to regional force posture. The single uncorroborated source reporting Oman's halt of cooperation with the US on Strait of Hormuz oil tanker escorts should be treated with low confidence until corroborated by additional reporting. The false alarm in the Kibbutz Alumim area highlights the sensitivity of early warning systems in southern Israel during the current period.
